description: This ScienceDB collection maps cropland at 30-metre resolution in the Yarlung Zangbo, Lhasa and Nyangqu river region of Tibet. The Aerospace Information Research Institute and University of Chinese Academy of Sciences used Landsat 5 and 8 imagery with a ResUnet classifier. Eight products represent 1990, 1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, 2020 and 2023. The public resource carries CC BY-NC 4.0 for free non-commercial reuse, although the top-level metadata does not state a file format. These maps can distribute agricultural land in irrigation-demand and land-transition simulations. Classification and cross-sensor adjustments introduce uncertainty; cropland presence alone does not reveal crop water demand or functioning irrigation assets. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
